title: Cell comments xlsx 001
notes: four real openpyxl Comment objects (author stichos-bot, fixed texts) on A1, A2, A3 and B2: openpyxl emits the CT_Comments part (authors table + commentList with ref/authorId) as xl/comments/comment1.xml (Excel itself would name it xl/comments1.xml; same part type), plus the legacy VML shape layer xl/drawings/commentsDrawing1.vml and the sheet-level relationship; comment parts carry no timestamp, so no wall-clock leaks. Comment texts are part of the reference text. Note: the metrics OOX key table is wordprocessing-only (w:*), so features{} shows zero w:comment/w:commentReference counts for xlsx — expected, the framework fills features from metrics, builders never set it.
